title: The Woman Who Fears the Lord

questions.question: An excellent wife who can find? She is far more precious than what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 31:10 (ESV): "She is far more precious than jewels."

questions.question: The heart of her husband trusts in her, and he will have no lack of what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 31:11 (ESV): "and he will have no lack of gain."

questions.question: She opens her mouth with wisdom, and the teaching of kindness is on her what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 31:26 (ESV): "and the teaching of kindness is on her tongue."

questions.question: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain, but a woman who fears the Lord is to be what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 31:30 (ESV): "but a woman who fears the Lord is to be praised."

questions.question: Give her of the fruit of her hands, and let her works praise her in the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 31:31 (ESV): "and let her works praise her in the gates."

questions.question: What, my son? What, O son of my womb? What, O son of my what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 31:2 (ESV): "What, O son of my vows?"

questions.question: Open your mouth for the mute, for the rights of all who are what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 31:8 (ESV): "for the rights of all who are destitute."

questions.question: She seeks wool and flax, and works with willing what?
She rises while it is yet night and provides food for her what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 31:15 (ESV): "and provides food for her household"

questions.question: Her children rise up and call her blessed; her husband also, and he does what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 31:28 (ESV): "her husband also, and he praises her:"

questions.question: Do not give your strength to women, your ways to those who destroy what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 31:3 (ESV): "your ways to those who destroy kings."

questions.question: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, or for rulers to take what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 31:4 (ESV): "or for rulers to take strong drink,"

questions.question: She considers a field and buys it; with the fruit of her hands she plants a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 31:16 (ESV): "with the fruit of her hands she plants a vineyard."

questions.question: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp does not go out at what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 31:18 (ESV): "Her lamp does not go out at night."

questions.question: She is not afraid of snow for her household, for all her household are clothed in what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 31:21 (ESV): "for all her household are clothed in scarlet."

key_verse_text: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain, but a woman who fears the Lord is to be praised.
